_comment: Every endpoint of every host with the expected status per caller (ARV-009). access is anonymous (allowlisted in allowlist.json), authenticated (any signed-in user), permission (any one of permissions, names from Global.Defaults.Permissions), device (a device credential only, ARV-022: every user caller gets 401) or simulation (a simulator operator key only, ARV-027: every user caller gets 401). Routes are the route templates; a {name:guid} parameter is called with routeValues.guid, an id that never exists, and an unconstrained {name} with routeValues.name (siteCode ZZ9, a site that never exists). body, when present, is sent as JSON and is chosen so the call fails the same way with or without a database (unknown user, wrong current password, unknown id; refresh without the CSRF header is 403 before any lookup), which keeps the in-process and E2E answers equal. Ariva.UnitTests fails when an endpoint is missing here, when a permission row disagrees with the role seed (RolePermissions), or when a host answers differently; the E2E suite reads the same rows with real tokens. A critical action ([RequiresRecentMfa], security/critical-actions.json) answers 401 mfa_required to every caller here, because the matrix callers have no recent second factor (ARV-010d). Add rows in the story that adds the endpoint.
